case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We understand that copper in particular has moved, and we take that seriously.

Having reviewed your figures, we cannot accept the price as quoted. We have prepared three options that reflect your cost situation fairly and keep the agreement simple, without an index clause:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 339.74; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 329.81; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 337.49; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Option C keeps your current payment terms unchanged. If your pricing committee needs any further detail to assess these options, please let us know and we will provide it promptly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your prompt response and the options provided. 

Our offer stands at a price of €372.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative at our standard terms, we can propose a price of €370.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. We are willing to make a slight concession to €370.50 while keeping the 30-day payment terms, which reflects the maximum we can accommodate under the current material cost pressure. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the movement on price. We recognise the pressure that copper is putting on your costs.

Even so, we are not yet able to accept it. We have adjusted our position and prepared three options, all without an index clause, so that each can go straight to your pricing committee:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 343.84; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 333.79; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 341.56; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Option C keeps your standard payment terms, which we understand matter to you. If your committee needs any further detail from us to review these options, please let us know and we will provide it promptly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and the movement on price. However, the sustained pressure from material costs strictly limits our flexibility. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our current Angebot is a price of €372.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Alternatively, under our standard terms, we can offer a further concession to €370.15 per unit, maintaining the 30-day payment terms, specifically a price of €370.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:

Thank you for your updated offer and for explaining the continued pressure from material costs. We respect that your calculation stays internal.

We have moved again and prepared three options, all without an index clause. Option C keeps your standard payment terms, and Option A matches the payment terms of your main offer. Each is set out so it can go straight to your pricing committee:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 347.38; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 337.23; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 345.08; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

If your committee needs anything further from us to reach a decision, please let us know and we will provide it promptly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your updated offer and for keeping the conversation constructive. We understand that material costs continue to limit your flexibility.

We have moved once more. The gap between our positions is still significant, and we see further small steps on both sides as the way to close it. All three options are without an index clause. Option A matches the payment terms of your main offer, and Option C keeps your standard payment terms:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 350.45; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 340.21; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 348.13; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Each option is set out so it can go straight to your pricing committee. If the committee needs anything further from us, please let us know.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer and the constructive steps taken to close the gap. The sustained pressure from material costs strictly limits our flexibility for larger steps. However, in response to your movement, we can offer a further concession to €371.70 per unit for the 60-day payment term. 

Consequently, our offer stands at a price of €371.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
